title: Night Cream for Combination Skin in Winter: How to Adjust Your Routine
ex: Combination skin changes in winter: dry cheeks get drier while the T-zone stays oily. A small, simple change to your night cream routine, zone by zone.
rt: Night Cream for Combination Skin in Winter | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for combination skin in winter: use a slightly richer cream on dry cheeks, keep the T-zone light, and add moisture in layers. Easy steps for India.
keyword: night cream for combination skin in winter
quick: In winter, keep the same night cream but use a little more on the cheeks and keep the T-zone light. If your cheeks still feel tight, add a thin second layer only there, or move to a slightly richer cream. Avoid hot water, which dries skin further.
facts: Cheeks need more cream in winter
